run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable and print its average execution time in milliseconds
test_time_func_warmup: test time_func warmup runs before measuring performance of a target function
test_time_func_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations for finer-grained benchmarking
review_time_func_api: review time_func to understand its warmup, iteration, and naming parameters
summarize_time_func: summarize time_func which benchmarks a function using perf_counter and reports average ms
